node.statement: The hypotheses of lem-maincb-stage3-call-envelope hold for the given A,w,U,V,v_U,v_V and the W facts in node 1.1.1. Hence, with R:=U union V, it certifies A_R=A_{U union V} as an extended epsilon_R-C*-algebra for epsilon_R:=W.L*epsilon and furnishes the explicit Stage-3 amplified four-corner raw-call datum at t_3:=W.K3*epsilon with rho<=C_cross^0*t_3; its envelope makes t_3 dominate epsilon_U,epsilon_V,d_U,d_V,epsilon_R, both displayed input-unit errors, and every other datum error.
